html:
If you require the services of a New York foreign language interpreter, contact American Education and Translation Services today. We offer reliable, affordable interpretation services for many different languages. Our rates start at just $75 an hour, and we can match you to the best interpreter based on your needs.

How to Hire Our Foreign Language Interpreter in New York NY

It’s easy to hire a language interpreter from American Education and Translation Services. Contact our local language interpreter agency in New York NY and include the following information:

  • Your contact info
  • The service you need
  • Time and date of the interpretation
  • Number of interpreters
  • Skill level of interpreters
  • Address of meeting
  • Method of interpretation, on site, phone, or online

Once we receive this information, our language interpreter agency in New York NY can provide you with an accurate price. Once we receive payment, we can schedule the interpretation at the time and date requested. All services are personalized, meaning you will get the best interpreter for your needs. If the interpretation is unsuccessful, we will refund your money.

Why Choose Our New York Language Interpreter Agency

American Education and Translation Services is a well-respected New York language interpreter agency. People choose us all the time to serve their translation and interpretation needs. Our physical offices allow for on-site interpretations and personalized service. Here are some reasons to choose our New York foreign language interpreter services

  • Referral rewards - we love rewarding our loyal customers!
  • Well-educated and professionally trained employees
  • Flexible appointments

Whether you’re an individual, business or organization in need of a foreign language interpreter in New York NY, contact our agency today. We can schedule fast appointments and provide you with the accurate service you deserve. Start the process by emailing our New York foreign language interpreter today.
